preconditions.description: The root must be either a Node object or None.
The value to be inserted must be an integer.
The number of values to be inserted must be between 1 and 500.

postconditions.description: The function must return a Node object representing the root of the modified AVL tree.

postconditions.expression: all(node.value != value for node in inorder_traversal(return_value))
postconditions.description: The value must be inserted into the tree, and the inorder traversal must not contain duplicate values.
The returned tree must maintain the AVL tree properties, ensuring it remains balanced.
